about: Oomba's picks from Bloom Library (scripts/import-bloom.js; docs/story-library-bloom.md). candidates: every Bloom book id considered (the importer checks each one); picks: books a person read in full and chose, with 3 questions each (two about the text, one inference; page = the page that answers it), optional glossary, credits read by a person where the book's credits cannot be split by role, and dropEnd (pages after the story, such as notes for grown-ups or a coloring page, left out with why); skipped: books read and left out, and why; scanReviewed: text-scanner flags a person read. Only Bloom book ids are kept: never a storage link or anyone's contact details.
